description: Address review findings: grid overflow in McpInspector, clearForm inconsistencies, and restore educational content in AgentGatewayTester.
steps: Fix grid overflow in McpInspector by adding a CSS modifier class that accounts for PageNav height.
Fix AgentGatewayTester clearForm to also reset argsText to '{}'.
Fix TokenSecurityTester handleClear to also reset selectedScenario state for full consistency.
Fix ResourceServerTester clearOutput to properly reset runner state instead of just deselecting.
Restore educational content in AgentGatewayTester: add structured P1AZ attribute table in Authorize Decision tab and 5W1H structured table in McpAudit tab, in addition to raw JSON.
acceptance_criteria: McpInspector grid does not overflow viewport when PageNav is present above it
AgentGatewayTester clearForm resets argsText to '{}' in addition to resp
All components Clear button resets both form state and output state consistently
AgentGatewayTester Authorize Decision tab shows structured P1AZ table when data exists
AgentGatewayTester McpAudit tab shows structured 5W1H table when data exists
verification: cd demo_api_ui && HTTPS=false npx vite build
findings: All 4 priority review issues addressed: (1) Grid overflow fixed with CSS modifier class p1mcp-grid--with-pagenav that reduces grid height by 50px when PageNav is present. (2) AgentGatewayTester clearForm now resets argsText to '{}', burstResp to null, and outputTab to 'result'. (3) All components now have consistent Clear behavior that resets both form state and output state. (4) Educational content restored in AgentGatewayTester with structured P1AZ attribute table (Decision, ToolName, ClientId, ActClientId, UserId, Scopes, RiskLevel, PolicyId, Reason) in Authorize Decision tab and 5W1H structured table (Who, What, When, Where, Why, How) in McpAudit tab, both shown above raw JSON. Build passes cleanly.
